stepInstruction: Wait until the red splash screen with the Obilet car logo appears.

condition.intent: Confirm the app has successfully launched and the initial loading screen is visible
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the main app logo is present on the splash screen.

stepInstruction: Wait until the white landing page loads and the Category Selection (Bus, Flight, Hotel) dashboard is displayed.

condition.intent: Confirm the application has initialized and is ready for user input on the main menu
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the main search form or category selector is visible.

stepInstruction: Switch to the 'Bus' category and set the search parameters to From: Istanbul Anatolia, To: Ankara for 10 April Friday.

condition.intent: Verify that the Bus category is active and the departure, destination, and date fields are correctly populated
condition.stepInstruction: Confirm the 'Bus' tab is selected and the route Istanbul to Ankara is shown for April 10.

stepInstruction: Click the green 'SEARCH' button to find available bus trips for the selected route and date.

condition.intent: Confirm that the search request was sent and the application has transitioned to the results loading state
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the loading animation and the text 'Flights are being listed...' (or similar) appear.

stepInstruction: Click the 'FILTER' button to open the bus trip filtering options.

condition.intent: Confirm that the filter menu has opened, allowing the user to sort by company, station, or time
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the Filter overlay is visible with categories like 'By Company' and 'By Station' at the top.

stepInstruction: Select 'Aksu Turizm', 'Adıyaman Anka Turizm', and 'Ben Turizm' from the company list and click the 'FILTER' button to apply.

condition.intent: Confirm that the trip list has been filtered to only show the selected companies
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the trip list displays a '3' on the Filter button and shows companies like 'Ben Turizm' and 'Anka'.

stepInstruction: Select the 22:00 AKSU trip from the list to view the seat availability and map.

condition.intent: Confirm that the seat map has opened for the selected 22:00 AKSU trip
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the seat layout with numbers and color-coded availability (Occupied-Male/Female) is displayed.

stepInstruction: Select Seat 12 and click the 'Confirm and Continue' button to proceed to passenger details.

condition.intent: Confirm that the seat is locked and the application has transitioned to the passenger detail entry screen
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the Passenger Info screen with name and ID fields is visible.

stepInstruction: Wait for the loading overlay to disappear and the Passenger Information form to load.

condition.intent: Verify that the user can now enter their name, surname, and ID number to finalize the booking
condition.stepInstruction: Confirm that the 'Loading, please wait...' message has closed and the form fields are interactable.
